name: web-care-app-website-on-floating-tilted-monitor-in-lilac
title: Care-app hero on a tilted monitor floating in lilac mist with a dashed route and credits
whatItIs: A large monitor tilted and floating in a lilac haze with a dashed white loop behind it, showing an indigo hero with 'Care, from anywhere.' in serif with yellow italic, a smiling older woman, store buttons and an award laurel, with small captions at the lower corners.
whatItMeans: Soothing and dreamy; the floating tilted screen feels light.
techniques: Tilt and float the monitor in a monochrome haze.
Trace a dashed route behind it.
Use serif with a yellow italic word.

vocabulary.definition: A device suspended without a surface.
A soft colour haze behind an object.
Small text in the lower corners.
